title: Charlie Puth apologizes to Manila fans during his concert: ‘It’s never going to happen again!’
summary: Multi-awarded singer and songwriter Charlie Puth addressed his fans during the start of the show at the Manila leg of his Whatever’s Clever world tour last October 14.
